verdicts.reason: A rearranges the headline onto one line, which suits the wide banner. It is centred, large and keeps the original serif weight, though the side margins are a little tight compared with the generous top and bottom space. B keeps the original two-line break, so it looks like a shrunk copy of the portrait design: the headline is too small for the canvas and leaves wide dead space on the left and right, so the banner shape is wasted.
